title: An absent PAYMENT-RESPONSE is not a failed settlement
description: PAYMENT-RESPONSE is optional on a delivered resource, so a header the merchant chose not to send commits: the resource arrived with a 2xx, and refusing to commit would release budget for a payment the merchant most likely did settle. Only an explicit success:false releases. A header that is *present* and does not decode is a different fact and has its own vector — conflating the two is the audit's O53.
